result.final: The seller showing the lowest 'as low as' price in the Wexcombe search results is Dovercourt Apparel at $10.13 (http://localhost:7770/igr-tcl-09.html). I read both results pages (page 1: items 1–36, page 2: items 37–45 of 45, no further page) and checked every listing's advertised price; $10.13 is the minimum across all 45 sellers. Next cheapest were Whitlock Outfitters ($11.09) and Carnforth Textile Company ($11.38).
